notes.subject: ol binatang bilong kai-kai gaden
notes.rationale: חסיל (hasel) na ארבה (arbeh) i tupela kain binatang bilong kaikai gaden; Tok Pisin i no gat ol nem bilong wanwan kain, olsem na wankain tok

notes.subject: יבולם / ויגיעם
notes.rationale: Tupela tok i tok wankain samting — kaikai bilong gaden na wok bilong han; ol rit i save lukim tupela i wok wantaim

translation: Em i givim ⟨את⟩ kaikai pikinini bilong ol gaden long ol binatang bilong kai-kai gaden, na ⟨את⟩ wok bilong ol long ol binatang bilong kai-kai gaden.
